ol.li: The current XT/FT exchange rate is 5.092 in the AMM.
55 XT includes the borrowed 55 USDC from the FT holder as a lender.
67 XT = 67 USDC to by collateral + 60.3 (67 * 0.9) USDC debt record

ol.li: The contract swap 52.4 (assume the current rate is 10%. 52.4 USDC x (1+10%) = 57.64 USDC) to 57.64 FT. Then repay the debt with 57.54 FT.
The remaining 5.24 USDC will be returned to the borrower.
After the borrower repays debt and get back the PT-sUSDe collateral, the contract burns the GT NFT and FT.
